description: This file contains the implementation of the Special module controller class in the OpenCart admin extension, responsible for managing the 'Special' module in the admin interface, including rendering the form, loading module data, and handling save actions.

classes.name: Special
classes.description: Controller class for handling the 'Special' module in the admin panel, including display, editing, and saving the module configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the module configuration page, loading existing module data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module settings via AJAX, including permission checks, validation, and response with JSON.
